spans.s:
अणु m. (-णुः)
 1. An atom, a minute and elementary particle of matter.
2. A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum, Rox.)
 m. or mfn. (-णुः-ण्वी-णु)
1. Atomic, small, minute.
 E. अण to sound, and उ Unādi aff.

अणुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
 1. Skilful, clever.
 2. Small, minute.
 E. अणु small,
and कन् aff.
अणुत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or being of an atom, also अणुता.

अणुभा f. (-भा) Lightning.
 E. अणु minute, and भा light.

अणुरेणु f. (-णुः) Small particles of dust, a dust of atoms.
 E. अणु, and
रेणु dust.

अणुरेणुजाल n. (लं) The motes in a sunbeam.
 E. अणुरेणु, and जाल as-
semblage.
